pairs.target: běi gōng fāng de zhuōzi bǐ tǎ wéi xiǎngxiàng de xiǎo .
pairs.english: The north workshop's table was smaller than Tavi expected.
pairs.hanzi: 北工坊的桌子比塔维想象的小。

pairs.target: gàoshì shàng xiě zhe huìtán , tā biàn yǐwéi huì yǒu yìjiān dàtīng , xǔduō yǐzi páichéng zhěngqí de xíng . dìliùshísān tiān wǔhòu , nài lěi lǐng tā jìnqù , wūlǐ zhǐyǒu yìzhāng chángzhuō , zhuōtuǐ páng duī zhe hái méi chāi de mùxiāng .
pairs.english: The notice said talks, so he imagined a hall with orderly rows of chairs. On day sixty-three, Nerai led him into a room with one long table and unopened crates by its legs.
pairs.hanzi: 告示上写着会谈，他便以为会有一间大厅，许多椅子排成整齐的行。第六十三天午后，奈蕾领他进去，屋里只有一张长桌，桌腿旁堆着还没拆的木箱。

pairs.target: tā zuótiān yǐ dāying ràng tā pángtīng , jīntiān jìn ménqián yòu shuō le yíbiàn : yǒu bù míngbái de xiān jì zhe , biétì shuí dáhuà . tǎ wéi diǎntóu , bǎ zìjǐ de dèngzǐ fàngdào qiángbiān .
pairs.english: She had agreed yesterday to let him observe. Before entering she repeated: note questions first, and answer for no one. He nodded and put his stool by the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 她昨天已答应让他旁听，今天进门前又说了一遍：有不明白的先记着，别替谁答话。塔维点头，把自己的凳子放到墙边。

pairs.target: zhuōbiān lái le liǎngchù huòzhàn de rén , yígè guǎnzhàng , yígè guǎn yùnshū . guǎn yùnshū de dài zhe zhéqǐlái de lùxiàntú , guǎnzhàng de xiān bǎ suànpán bǎihǎo .
pairs.english: Two freight-station representatives came, one for accounts, one for transport. Transport brought a folded route map; accounts set out an abacus.
pairs.hanzi: 桌边来了两处货站的人，一个管账，一个管运输。管运输的带着折起来的路线图，管账的先把算盘摆好。

pairs.target: zhǔ wèi kōng zhe , cháhú què fàngzài nàér , shuí yào shuǐ jiù shēnshǒu dǎo .
pairs.english: The head seat was empty, holding only a teapot within everyone's reach.
pairs.hanzi: 主位空着，茶壶却放在那儿，谁要水就伸手倒。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ jiù hékǒu de jìlù tānkāi . línshí chuán yǐjīng àn yuē zǒu le shíláitiān , fēng dà de liǎnggè xiàwǔ tíng le , yàobāo gǎi zài cìrì sòng .
pairs.english: Nerai opened the Old Rivermouth records. The temporary boats had run for over ten days; two windy afternoons had been cancelled, with medicine delivered the next day.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把旧河口的记录摊开。临时船已经按约走了十来天，风大的两个下午停了，药包改在次日送。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tíngháng rìqī niàn chūlái , méiyǒu yīnwèi jīntiān lái tán xù qián jiù shěngdiào nàxiē rìzi . guǎn yùnshū de rén tīng wán , shuō jìrán nà liǎngtiān xiàwǔ méi kāi , zhàng shàng yīngdāng kòudiào .
pairs.english: She read the cancellation dates without omitting them to ease today's funding talks. Transport said those cancelled afternoons should be deducted.
pairs.hanzi:
她把停航日期念出来，没有因为今天来谈续钱就省掉那些日子。
管运输的人听完，说既然那两天下午没开，账上应当扣掉。

pairs.target: nài lěi wèn tā , chuán hé rén shìbushì yǐjīng zhào yuē dào le ànbiān . " dào le yě méi yùn . "
pairs.english: Nerai asked whether the boats and crews had arrived as agreed. “Arrived, but carried nothing.”
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾问他，船和人是不是已经照约到了岸边。
“到了也没运。”

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le yíxià . tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ tā huílái nàtiān jiǎng guò de děnghòu gōngqián , yuánlái xiě dào zhǐ shàng yǐhòu , hái dé zài jiǎng yícì .
pairs.english: Silence fell. Tavi remembered her account of paid waiting; even written agreements had to be explained again.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了一下。塔维想起她回来那天讲过的等候工钱，原来写到纸上以后，还得再讲一次。

pairs.target: kàochuāng de nǚrén bǎ bēizi fàngxià . tā chuān yíjiàn xiùkǒu mó bái de duǎnyī , jiǎo biān yǒu gè biǎn mùhé , yìzhí méiyǒu dǎkāi .
pairs.english: The woman by the window set down her cup. Her short coat had worn cuffs, a flat wooden case lay unopened at her feet.
pairs.hanzi: 靠窗的女人把杯子放下。她穿一件袖口磨白的短衣，脚边有个扁木盒，一直没有打开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā shì huòzhàn dàilái de , zhídào tā shuō zìjǐ qiántiān hái zài nàduàn shuǐbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi assumed she came with the station staff, until she said she had been at that stretch of water two days ago.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为她是货站带来的，直到她说自己前天还在那段水边。

pairs.target: " tíng shì zhào yuē tíng de . jiào rén qù le , zài fá tā méi màoxiǎn guòhé , xiàhuí nǐ cāi tā tīng nǎ yíjù ? "
pairs.english: “They stopped as agreed. Call them in, then penalize them for not risking the crossing: which instruction will they follow next time?”
pairs.hanzi: “停是照约停的。叫人去了，再罚他没冒险过河，下回你猜他听哪一句？”

pairs.target: tā shēngyīn bú dà , guǎnzhàng de rén què tíng le bō zhūzǐ de shǒu .
pairs.english: She spoke quietly, but the accountant stopped moving the beads.
pairs.hanzi: 她声音不大，管账的人却停了拨珠子的手。

pairs.target: guǎn yùnshū de rén shuō , zìjǐ búshì jiào rén màoxiǎn , zhǐshì qián yǒuxiàn , yào yǒu gè shuōfǎ .
pairs.english: Transport said he was not asking for risks, but funds were limited and required justification.
pairs.hanzi: 管运输的人说，自己不是叫人冒险，只是钱有限，要有个说法。

pairs.target: tā bǎ lùxiàntú zhǎnkāi , zhǐchū ràoxíng de dàchē réng duō zǒu yì zhěngduàn , biéchù yě zài yào xiūlù de qián .
pairs.english: He opened the map, pointing out the extra distance for detouring freight carts and other roads also needing repair funds.
pairs.hanzi: 他把路线图展开，指出绕行的大车仍多走一整段，别处也在要修路的钱。

pairs.target: nǚrén kàn le tú , diǎntóu shuō zhè búshì jiǎhuà , suíjí bǎ nài lěi nà zhāng biǎo tuī dào pángbiān . " nà jiù bǎ ràolù de qián lìng suàn . bié ná zhè tiáo chuán de zhàng , qù tì nàtiáo lù shǎo xiě yìbǐ . "
pairs.english: The woman acknowledged that was true, then pushed Nerai's sheet aside. “Count the detour separately. Don't use this boat's account to erase that road's costs.”
pairs.hanzi:
女人看了图，点头说这不是假话，随即把奈蕾那张表推到旁边。
“那就把绕路的钱另算。别拿这条船的账，去替那条路少写一笔。”

pairs.target: liǎngbiān shuō dào zhèlǐ , tǎ wéi cái fāxiàn zhuōshàng méiyǒu yígè rén shì zhuānmén tì huáchuán de rén lái de . tā wǎng ménkǒu kàn le yìyǎn , hǎoxiàng wǎnyìdiǎn hái huì yǒurén jìnlái .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi notice nobody at the table had come specifically for the rowers. He glanced at the door as though someone might still arrive.
pairs.hanzi: 两边说到这里，塔维才发现桌上没有一个人是专门替划船的人来的。他往门口看了一眼，好像晚一点还会有人进来。

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng cèzǐ lǐ chōuchū liǎngyè zhǐ . chuánjiā tuō tā dài le gōngshí hé tiáojiàn , hái zài mòwěi xiě le míngzì .
pairs.english: Nerai withdrew two pages: the boat family had entrusted her with hours and conditions, signing at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从册子里抽出两页纸。船家托她带了工时和条件，还在末尾写了名字。

pairs.target: tā shuōmíng zìjǐ kěyǐ zhuǎn huà , bùnéng tì tāmen bǎ kāichuán de shíchén gǎidiào . kàochuāng de nǚrén jiàn guò tāmen , dàn yě búshì lái dàiqiān de .
pairs.english: She could convey their words, not change departure times for them. The woman had met them but could not sign for them either.
pairs.hanzi: 她说明自己可以转话，不能替他们把开船的时辰改掉。靠窗的女人见过他们，但也不是来代签的。

pairs.target: guǎnzhàng de rén jiāng liǎngchù huòzhàn de zhàng bìng qǐlái kàn le hěn jiǔ , zuìhòu shuō , yǐjīng shǒu guò de shíduàn xiān àn jiùyuē fù , bù yīnwèi zhào tíngháng tiáojiàn bànshì zài kòu .
pairs.english: The accountant studied both stations' accounts, then agreed to pay attendance under the existing terms, with no deduction for required cancellation.
pairs.hanzi: 管账的人将两处货站的账并起来看了很久，最后说，已经守过的时段先按旧约付，不因为照停航条件办事再扣。

pairs.target: jiēxiàlái kěyǐ zàixù yígèyuè , búguò liǎngbiān gè chū duōshǎo , yào jīntiān xiě qīng .
pairs.english: They could extend another month, but each station's share must be written today.
pairs.hanzi: 接下来可以再续一个月，不过两边各出多少，要今天写清。

pairs.target: hòumiàn tán dé hěn màn . tǎ wéi xiānqián yǐwéi yǒurén shuōchū yíjù yǒu dàolǐ dehuà , shìqíng jiù huì wǎngqiánzǒu ; xiànzài cái zhīdào , yǒushí wǎngqiánzǒu de shì yìméi bèi tuīláituīqù de suànpán zhūzǐ .
pairs.english: Talk dragged on. Tavi had thought a reasonable sentence would move things forward; sometimes all that moved was an abacus bead pushed back and forth.
pairs.hanzi: 后面谈得很慢。塔维先前以为有人说出一句有道理的话，事情就会往前走；现在才知道，有时往前走的是一枚被推来推去的算盘珠子。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ nàxiē shù quán chāoxiàlái , zhī jì le jǐchù zhōngyú tīng míngbái dehuà . chuánjiā búbì bái děng , xià yīyuè de qián yǒu le zhuóluò , dàchē réng méiyǒu cóng shuǐshàng guòqù .
pairs.english: He did not copy every number, only what he finally understood: waiting would be paid, next month funded, carts still could not cross.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把那些数全抄下来，只记了几处终于听明白的话。船家不必白等，下一月的钱有了着落，大车仍没有从水上过去。

pairs.target: suǒ dù yòng de nà jiàn tiě liàodào le zhōngzhuǎnzhàn , shàngwèi yànshōu , gèng méiyǒu zhuāng shàng .
pairs.english: The cable-ferry fitting had reached the transfer station but was not yet inspected or installed.
pairs.hanzi: 索渡用的那件铁料到了中转站，尚未验收，更没有装上。

pairs.target: sànhuì qián , nài lěi bǎ xīn xiě de zhǐ cóngtóu niàn le yíbiàn , wèn tāmen nǎ yífèn gěi chuánjiā . guǎnzhàng de rén lìng chāo yífèn , chuīgān mò , jiāogěi yǒu gùdìngbāncì de sòngxìnrén dàizǒu .
pairs.english: Before closing, Nerai read the new paper through and asked which copy went to the boat family. The accountant copied one, dried the ink and gave it to a regular messenger.
pairs.hanzi: 散会前，奈蕾把新写的纸从头念了一遍，问他们哪一份给船家。管账的人另抄一份，吹干墨，交给有固定班次的送信人带走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng wūlǐrén shǎo le cái wèn , gāngcái shìbushì suàn yíng le . nài lěi jiāng bēizi lǐ de liángshuǐ hēwán . " tāmen xiàgèyuè néng nádào qián , suàn bànchéng le yíjiàn . biéde hái zài nàér . "
pairs.english: When the room emptied, Tavi asked if they had won. Nerai finished her cold water. “They can be paid next month. One thing done. The rest remains.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维等屋里人少了才问，刚才是不是算赢了。
奈蕾将杯子里的凉水喝完。
“他们下个月能拿到钱，算办成了一件。别的还在那儿。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu wèn tā xuéhuì shénme , zhuǎnshēn xiān qù bān dǎngzhù mén de xiāngzǐ . kàochuāng de nǚrénbāng tā tái lìngyìtóu , tǎ wéi ràng kāilù , děng xiāngzǐ fàng hǎo cái wèn tā shìbushì míngtiān lái jiǎngkè de rén .
pairs.english: She did not ask what he learned, but moved a crate blocking the door. The woman helped; Tavi stepped aside, then asked if she was tomorrow's speaker.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有问他学会什么，转身先去搬挡住门的箱子。靠窗的女人帮她抬另一头，塔维让开路，等箱子放好才问她是不是明天来讲课的人。

pairs.target: tā shuō shì , jiào lā shā , cóng dī dì lú wān lái , tì nàlǐ de xiūzào pù sòng jǐjiàn jiù yàng . tā tīngjiàn dī dì , mùguāng biàn luòdào tā de mùhé shàng .
pairs.english: Yes: Lasha, from Reedbay in the lowlands, delivering old samples for its repair shop. At “lowlands,” his eyes went to her case.
pairs.hanzi: 她说是，叫菈莎，从低地芦湾来，替那里的修造铺送几件旧样。他听见低地，目光便落到她的木盒上。

pairs.target: " lǐmiàn shì shénme ? " " biérén bùkěn àn tú zuò , wǒ zhǐhǎo ná zhēnde gěi tāmen kàn . "
pairs.english: “What's inside?” “They won't make it from a drawing, so I brought the real thing.”
pairs.hanzi:
“里面是什么？”
“别人不肯按图做，我只好拿真的给他们看。”

pairs.target: tā dǎkāi hégài , lǐmiàn bìng méiyǒu fāliàng de kuàngshí , érshì yìzhī biānjiǎo fāhēi de tiětào , pángbiān diàn zhe jǐpiàn báo mù .
pairs.english: She opened the case: inside was no shining mineral, just an iron sleeve with blackened corners, cushioned with thin wood.
pairs.hanzi: 她打开盒盖，里面并没有发亮的矿石，而是一只边角发黑的铁套，旁边垫着几片薄木。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūnxiàlái , kànchū nà tiětào búshì huài le cái fēnchéng liǎngbàn , běnlái jiù néng chāi . lā shā jiàn tā xiǎng ná , biàn jiāng hézi zhuǎn dào tā miànqián , shuō kěyǐ , zhī bié bǎ liǎngbàn zhuāng fǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched and saw it was split by design, not broken. She turned the case toward him: he could hold it, but not reverse the halves.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维蹲下来，看出那铁套不是坏了才分成两半，本来就能拆。
菈莎见他想拿，便将盒子转到他面前，说可以，只别把两半装反。

pairs.target: tiětào bǐ tā xiǎng de chén , tā yòng liǎngzhīshǒu tuōzhù . nài lěi zài pángbiān wèn tā wǎnshàng zhùchù zhǎo hǎo méiyǒu , tā shuō zhǎo hǎo le , zhǐshì chuáng bǐ jiàqián duǎn .
pairs.english: It was heavier than he expected; he supported it with both hands. Nerai asked if she had found lodging. Yes, but the bed was shorter than the price.
pairs.hanzi:
铁套比他想的沉，他用两只手托住。
奈蕾在旁边问她晚上住处找好没有，她说找好了，只是床比价钱短。

pairs.target: liǎng rén xiào qǐlái . tǎ wéi mō zhe nà dào néng dǎkāi de fèng , hūrán xiǎng zhīdào , zài lú wān , shénme dōngxī xūyào zhèyàng de tàozǐ .
pairs.english: They laughed. Feeling the opening seam, Tavi wondered what needed such a sleeve in Reedbay.
pairs.hanzi: 两人笑起来。塔维摸着那道能打开的缝，忽然想知道，在芦湾，什么东西需要这样的套子。

pairs.target: lā shā bǎ hégài wǎnghòu chēng wěn . " míngtiān dài nǐmen kàn tā zhuāng zài nǎér . "
pairs.english: Lasha propped the lid back. “Tomorrow I'll show you where it fits.”
pairs.hanzi:
菈莎把盒盖往后撑稳。
“明天带你们看它装在哪儿。”
